prompts.Refinery: Use case: design-mockup. Asset: premium PC game UI concept, REFINERY. A single polished 16:9 screenshot mockup, precise flat interface, same restrained industrial machinery-yellow #E8B526 / neutral charcoal #141619 / ivory design as a professional AAA pause menu. No branding, no Dune Company text, no slogans. Dim low-poly orange alien canyon mining camp behind; compact right-side panel only about 42% screen width, leave world clearly visible. Header REFINERY, small close X and credits 240 cr. Show RAW ORE 120 and REFINED 54 as clear two-line summary. Active processing section: 'REFINING' with yellow horizontal progress bar 62%, '12 / 20 ore' and '1.1s remaining'. Three compact upgrade rows with small crisp monochrome pictograms: 'Batch size' '20 > 32' '30 cr'; 'Processing time' '3.0s > 2.5s' '40 cr'; 'Recovery yield' '1.00x > 1.10x' '55 cr'. Each row has a distinct modest buy button on right, no oversized empty cards. Footer one wide solid-yellow button 'REFINE & RETURN', small 'ESC CLOSE'. Thin slate rules, generous readable spacing, clean sans serif typography, tiny drawn square markers, crisp yellow focus. Attractive functional production game UI, no green, no grunge, no glowing sci fi frames, no mobile rounded corners, no extra menus or headers outside the screenshot.
prompts.AmmoPress: Use case: design-mockup. Single AAA PC game interface screenshot concept for AMMO PRESS, 16:9 landscape. Deliberate minimal industrial UI, neutral charcoal #141619, machinery yellow #E8B526 and ivory, crisp clean sans serif. No game name, no logo, no slogan. Low-poly orange alien canyon mining camp behind, small yellow ammunition production machine with conveyor delivering brass cartridges into a holding bin visible on left. Compact right-side panel 42% width, preserve the game view. Header 'AMMO PRESS', close X, credits '240 cr'. Clear operational state 'PRODUCING', thin yellow cycle progress 72%, '3 rounds / second'. Holding bin diagram small white bin icon, 'BUCKET' and '64 / 100', thin capacity gauge. Small muted instruction 'Walk up to the bucket to collect ammo'. Three compact upgrade rows with white pictograms and modest yellow buy buttons: 'Cycle speed' '3/s > 4/s' '35 cr'; 'Hopper capacity' '100 > 150' '25 cr'; 'Rounds / stroke' '1 > 2' '40 cr'. Show tidy small level pips. Footer 'ESC CLOSE' only, NO COLLECT button because collection is automatic walk-up, no unnecessary extra click. Thin slate dividers and drawn square markers. Flat surfaces, no olive green, no rounded mobile cards, no glowing frames, generous clear spacing, professional shipped-game readability. Make this the exact same UI family as a yellow/charcoal minimalist pause menu.
